hooks.command: IN=$(cat); R="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -n "$P" ] && [ -n "$R" ] && [ -f "$R/scripts/codex_hook_bridge.py" ]; then printf %s "$IN" | "$P" "$R/scripts/codex_hook_bridge.py" dispatch PreToolUse; fi
hooks.commandWindows: if defined PLUGIN_ROOT (py -3 "%PLUGIN_ROOT%\scripts\codex_hook_bridge.py" dispatch PreToolUse) else if defined CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\scripts\codex_hook_bridge.py" dispatch PreToolUse)
